import sys

def initialize_choose(maxN, P):
    choose = [[0] * (maxN + 1) for _ in range(maxN + 1)]
    for i in range(maxN + 1):
        choose[i][0] = 1
        choose[i][i] = 1
        for j in range(1, i):
            choose[i][j] = (choose[i - 1][j - 1] + choose[i - 1][j]) % P
    return choose

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    N, M, P = map(int, input_data[:3])
    choose = initialize_choose(N, P)

    dp1 = [0] * (N + 1)
    dpw = [1] * (N + 1)

    for m in range(1, M + 1):
        for i in range(m):
            w = (dpw[i] * dpw[m - 1 - i]) % P
            w = (w * choose[m - 1][i]) % P
            dpw[m] = (dpw[m] + w * (m + 1)) % P

            s1 = (dp1[i] * dpw[m - 1 - i]) % P
            s2 = (dp1[m - 1 - i] * dpw[i]) % P
            add = ((s1 + s2) % P) * (m + 1) % P * choose[m - 1][i] % P
            add = (add + w * (((i * (i + 1) + (m - 1 - i) * (m - i)) // 2))) % P
            dp1[m] = (dp1[m] + add) % P

    dp = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    dps = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    for i in range(N + 1):
        for j in range(M + 1):
            dp[i][j] = 0
            dps[i][j] = 0
    dps[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        dp[i][i] = dp1[i]
        dps[i][i] = dpw[i]
        dps[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]
            dps[i][j] = dps[i - 1][j]
            for k in range(1, j + 1):
                dps[i][j] = (dps[i][j] + dpw[k] * dps[i - k - 1][j - k] % P * choose[j][k]) % P
                add = ( (dp[i - k - 1][j - k] * dpw[k]) % P + (dps[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp1[k]) % P ) % P
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + add * choose[j][k]) % P

    print(dp[N][M])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
